findingDetails.title: An or-list whose non-final item is a two-word /doctor command still publishes the refused command
findingDetails.scopeProof: COMMAND_OR_LIST matches one command token (command-attach.ts:380) and is applied at :427, :429, :432 and :439; TRACKED_COMMANDS ships 22 two-word /doctor rows (:143-178) and fusion.ts:1209 withholds a command row on the base name, whose second occurrence is never bridged.
findingDetails.claim: A refusal or a question over an or-list still carries a command when a non-final list item is a two-word /doctor command, so the refused command is published.
evidenceRefs: advisor CLI: do not run /doctor:ci report or /doctor:ci scaffold -> command-doctor-ci-report /doctor:ci report run, command-doctor-ci-scaffold /doctor:ci scaffold ask
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: REQ-001 names only three single-word refusals; A3 and the Out-of-Scope line (P049) record a question over an or-list as unreproduced, but no record declares two-word commands out of the or-list grammar. SA4-P1-001 and SA4-P1-003 are different accepted limits. A two-word final item works, so the failure is positional.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: T028 authored the item pattern with one token on purpose, so the authors may treat a two-word /doctor command as outside the or-list shape. That is not recorded, and the constant comment claims every joined command while TRACKED_COMMANDS ships the two-word rows.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if a packet doc or adjudication record declares the or-list grammar single-token only, or declares multi-word /doctor commands out of the typed-command and command-row withholding contract.

results.note: REQ-001's three refusals pass at the CLI; the code comment's 'every command the list joins' fails for two-word /doctor items.
T028 and T029 are [x] with matching verifier evidence; AC-001 and AC-006 stay Unmet until this round closes under AC-011.

noveltyJustification: First iteration of this lineage: one new P1 raised from a real-module and CLI probe, no refinement of prior state. The fixed single-word forms are confirmed rather than re-reported.
